320	Forty.	Quarenta.
321	Forty.	Quarenta.
322	What happened?	O que aconteceu?
323	Was he stuck in shidduchim?	Ele estava encalhado no shidduch?
324	Why didn't he marry earlier?	Por que não se casou antes?
325	At 18 to the chuppah.	Aos 18 anos, para a chupá.
326	What was he doing for 40 years?	O que ele fez durante 40 anos?
327	How did he not find a match?	Como não achou um shidduch?
328	Until age 40 he found no match?	Até os 40 anos não achou um shidduch?
329	Today they would call him a stuck-in-shidduchim case.	Hoje o chamariam de encalhado no shidduch.
330	What would people say?	O que as pessoas diriam?
331	No, that was the question.	Não, essa era a pergunta.
332	But with Yitzchak it's not comparable, because Yitzchak Avinu, his match had not yet been born.	Mas com Yitzchak não é comparável, porque Yitzchak Avinu ainda não tinha nascido o seu shidduch.
333	Only at the Akeidah was his match born, when he was told Rivkah was born, and he took her at age three.	Só na Akedá nasceu o seu shidduch, quando lhe anunciaram que Rivká nascera, e ele a tomou com três anos.
334	But today, today that is a relatively late age.	Mas hoje, hoje essa é uma idade relativamente tardia.
335	I didn't understand at all.	Eu não entendi nada.
336	So now, the Kli Yakar writes: why did Avraham Avinu go to Padan Aram to bring	Então agora, o Kli Yakar escreve: por que Avraham Avinu foi a Padan Aram buscar
337	a wife from there?	uma esposa de lá?
338	There are plenty of fish in the sea.	Há muitos peixes no mar.
339	Here in the land of Canaan, were there no women?	Aqui na terra de Canaã faltavam mulheres?
340	There were women.	Havia mulheres.
341	So why did he go there?	Então por que foi até lá?
342	He writes: good midot in Padan Aram, so writes the Kli Yakar, and I wonder.	Ele escreve: boas midot em Padan Aram, assim escreve o Kli Yakar, e eu me espanto.
343	A tremendous wonder.	Um espanto enorme.
344	Good midot?	Boas midot?
345	Yes.	Sim.
346	Good midot in Padan Aram?	Boas midot em Padan Aram?
347	They tried to murder him, to kill him, they switched his cups, they wanted to rob him, they wanted to delay	Tentaram assassiná-lo, matá-lo, trocaram os copos dele, quiseram roubá-lo, quiseram atrasar
348	everything: "Let the girl stay with us a year or ten months," after they had already said yes,	tudo: "Que a moça fique conosco um ano ou dez meses", depois de já terem dito sim,
349	"Take Rivkah and go." To delay the match, to murder him. He tried to murder him, and in the end Betuel died,	"Leve Rivká e vá." Atrasar o shidduch, assassiná-lo. Tentou assassiná-lo, e no fim Betuel morreu,
350	Rivkah's father. Lavan tried to rob him: when her brother saw the bracelets	o pai de Rivká. Lavan tentou roubá-lo: quando o irmão dela viu as pulseiras
351	that the servant had put on her hand, he immediately ran outside. What made him run?	que o servo pusera em sua mão, saiu correndo na hora. O que o fez correr?
352	What were the incentives?	Quais eram os incentivos?
353	Monetary ones, those were the incentives. And furthermore, why is he called Lavan?	Os financeiros, esses eram os incentivos. E mais, por que ele é Lavan?
354	"Lavan HaArami": Chazal expound "HaArami" as "the swindler," the swindler. He was a swindler, it's also not	"Lavan haArami": Chazal interpretam "haArami" como "o enganador", o enganador. Ele era um enganador, também não foi	
355	for nothing that they called him Lavan. He was a salesman, he was a user,	à toa que o chamaram Lavan. Ele era vendedor, era aproveitador,
356	he was one of the users. So you come and tell me good midot?	era um dos aproveitadores. E você vem me dizer boas midot?
357	What good midot?	Que boas midot?
358	Are these good midot?	Isso são boas midot?
359	They tried to murder him, to spoil, to deceive, to steal, to rob, to destroy, to ... these are	Tentaram assassiná-lo, estragar, enganar, roubar, saquear, destruir, … isso são
